verdict.rationale: The only openness evidence is a public GitHub repo for the JavaScript SDK (braintrust-sdk-javascript), which shows SDK source is readable, but no license is stated. The self-hosting docs say Braintrust still provides the managed UI, authentication and platform updates, which implies the core platform is not open source. Missing for 10: evidence of an OSI/open license on any repo, source availability for the core platform/UI, and independent corroboration.
